description: Creates a NEW webinar from a full export payload, which is how a host moves a webinar to another site or restores one. Side effect: it always creates a new campaign and never touches an existing one; the new webinar starts with the state the payload carries. Needs `session_id` and the `payload` JSON string from wi_export_webinar or from the Export button in the dashboard; `title` gives the new campaign a name. The payload is large, so only use this when the host hands it over on purpose. Read the payload with wi_export_webinar first. For a legacy HC campaign there is wi_import_legacy_webinar.

payload.description: The export payload as a JSON string. At most 200000 characters.

session_id.description: From an earlier turn (weiter · texte · stand).

title.description: The title of the new campaign. Leave it out to take the one in the payload.

name: wi_import_webinar
title: Create a webinar from an export payload
